metadata.Name: HOTPOTQA
metadata.Description: A dataset for diverse, explainable multi-hop question answering
Provider: Mila, Universit´ e de Montr´ eal
metadata.Paper Title: HOTPOTQA: A Dataset for Diverse, Explainable Multi-hop Question Answering
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 2018 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
Affiliations: Mila, Universit´ e de Montr´ eal
metadata.Abstract: Existing question answering (QA) datasets fail to train QA systems to perform complex reasoning and provide explanations for answers. We introduce HOTPOTQA, a new dataset with 113k Wikipedia-based question-answer pairs with four key features: (1) the questions require finding and reasoning over multiple supporting documents to answer; (2) the questions are diverse and not constrained to any pre-existing knowledge bases or knowledge schemas; (3) we provide sentence-level supporting facts required for reasoning, allowing QA systems to reason with strong supervision and explain the predictions; (4) we offer a new type of factoid comparison questions to test QA systems' ability to extract relevant facts and perform necessary comparison.
